To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) global efficiency, path length and transitivity are able to describe the properties of a multi-subject network reproducing typical social situations, and 2) these indexes are able to describe real inter-brain connectivity during social and non-social interactions.
global efficiency and path-length indices are able to capture the properties of brain-to-brain network, while other indices, such as characteristic path length, are not.
global efficiency is able to detect the level of interbrain synchronization in a social context.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the extension of graph theory to the multi-subject case, with the aim to provide an effective tool for describing the properties of inter-brain connectivity.
the extension of the graph theory approach to the study of the inter-brain network.
the application of graph theory approach for the analysis of brain-to-brain functional connectivity in hyperscanning experiments.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the investigated global indices are able to describe the properties of a multi-subject network and that their use could represent a valid tool in the study of the brain-to-brain interactions.
global efficiency and path-length indexes are the best candidates for a graph theory approach to the analysis of brain-to-brain interaction.
global efficiency and path lengths can be used as reliable indicators of the social interaction between two subjects.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the investigated global indexes are able to detect the presence of inter-subjects communication and the direction of the information flow.
graph theory approach can be applied to multi-subject networks.
the global efficiency index, among the investigated, is the most suitable to describe brain-to-brain network properties.
The main takeaway from our work is that
global indices can provide useful information about the interaction level between subjects in social scenarios.
the use of global graph theory measures is a promising approach to describe the properties of brain-to-brain interaction networks.
the global efficiency index, which is the most commonly used, is able to detect the presence of an inter-subject interaction.
